statement_made: I know I’m a big guy, but I want people to see how I move. I’m ready to protect Justin and help this team win.
event_description: Addressing the media about his rare size and mobility after being drafted by the Chargers.

statement_made: The Raiders have a vision for this offensive line, and I’m honored to be a part of it. Let's get to work, Vegas.
event_description: First public statement after being selected in the first round by the Las Vegas Raiders.

statement_made: We wanted to get bigger and meaner upfront. Jonah (Savaiinaea) brings that edge we need in the AFC West.
event_description: Raiders HC explaining the selection of the first-round offensive lineman.

statement_made: The Bears fans have been amazing already. I’m ready to give them my all every Sunday.
event_description: Expressing appreciation for the warm reception from Chicago fans during draft weekend.

statement_made: Jake (Golday) has the instincts that you just can’t teach. He fits perfectly into the aggressive style we want to play.
event_description: Vikings Defensive Coordinator praising the draft selection of linebacker Jake Golday.

statement_made: I’ve been the underdog my whole life. I’m ready to show the world what the Raiders saw in me.
event_description: Reflecting on his journey from an 'underrated' prospect to a second-round pick.

statement_made: David (Bailey) is a pure pass rusher. His bend and his motor are at an elite level.
event_description: Raiders GM justifying the No. 2 overall selection of David Bailey.

statement_made: New England is getting a worker. I’m ready to learn from the best and hold down that line.
event_description: First public reaction after being selected by the Patriots in the late rounds.

statement_made: This is just the start. I’m ready to prove I belong on this stage and make Miami proud.
event_description: Reacting to his selection as an International Player Pathway prospect by the Dolphins.

statement_made: Seydou (Traore) has physical gifts you just can't coach. We are excited to see his development under this staff.
event_description: Dolphins GM discussing the upside of rookie tight end Seydou Traore.

statement_made: I’m a physical receiver. I want to be the guy Daniel (Jones) can trust in those tough situations.
event_description: Discussing his playing style and goals for his rookie season with the Giants.

statement_made: I’m ready to contribute anywhere—defense, special teams, you name it. Just happy to be a Giant.
event_description: Expressing his willingness to help the team in any capacity after being drafted.

statement_made: Tory (Horton) has that vertical threat we were looking for to complement our room. He's an exciting addition.
event_description: Bengals HC discussing the third-round selection of wide receiver Tory Horton.

statement_made: Evan (Stewart) is an elite route runner. His ability to create separation is something we value highly.
event_description: Eagles GM recapping the first-round selection of wide receiver Evan Stewart.

statement_made: I want to be a dominant force in the middle. The Vikings fans deserve a defense that plays with fire.
event_description: First interview after being selected in the first round by the Minnesota Vikings.

statement_made: Caleb (Banks) provides a physical presence we needed on the interior. He has a high ceiling as a disruptor.
event_description: Vikings GM explaining the draft selection of defensive tackle Caleb Banks.

statement_made: Coach Quinn has a plan for me, and I’m ready to execute it. DC, let’s hunt.
event_description: Expressing excitement about playing under Dan Quinn in Washington.

statement_made: I’ve worked for this moment. Ready to bring some pressure to the NFC South with the Bucs.
event_description: Reflecting on his journey to the NFL after being drafted by Tampa Bay.

statement_made: The Steelers defense has a legendary history. I’m honored to be a part of it and ready to compete.
event_description: Draft night response after being selected by the Pittsburgh Steelers.

statement_made: Benjamin (Morrison) is a competitor. He loves the challenge of being on an island and he fits our culture.
event_description: Steelers HC praising the competitive spirit of rookie corner Benjamin Morrison.
